annotation.title_clean: Regulatory Impact Assessment for the Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations 2024
annotation.title_en: Regulatory Impact Assessment for the Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Roads and Transport (Kenya); Kenya Civil Aviation Authority
named_instruments_referenced: Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention)
ICAO Annex 6 Part IV and Model UAS Regulations
annotation.summary_en: Kenya's Regulatory Impact Assessment for the draft Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations 2024. It sets out the legal mandate, ICAO alignment, stakeholder consultation and a cost-benefit comparison of three options. It recommends promulgating the regulations to ensure safe drone integration, certification, registration and licensing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends promulgating the 2024 UAS Regulations (Option 3) over status quo or administrative measures.
Regulations cover drone registration, certification, remote pilot licensing, airworthiness, operational limits and airspace permissions.
Provides requirements for highly autonomous and highly automatic UAS operations.
Aligns Kenya with ICAO Annex 6 Part IV and Model UAS Regulations under the Chicago Convention.
Requires safety management systems, incident reporting and mandatory liability insurance; State aircraft are excluded.
